title: Flexjet US Praetor / EMB-545 + EMB-550 roster (public sources only)
notes: Honest incomplete roster — registrations cited from public FAA mirrors and ADS-B databases only; no invented tails.
FAA model EMB-545/EMB-550 covers Legacy and Praetor families; live map filter still requires LXJ callsign + E545/E550.
Mode-S hex included only when observed in ADSB.lol or listed on flightdb.net — never fabricated.
Source page aircraftdata.org/reg-name/flexjet-llc/ mirrors FAA Aircraft Registry and may lag official Flexjet dispatch/Tailwind lists.
Full official fleet reconciliation may take a second pass.
